title: KDHNet: A Knowledge-Driven Hybrid Network for Limited-Calibration SSVEP Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33058v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) achieve high information transfer rates but often require sufficient subject-specific calibration data for reliable decoding. Analytical spatial filters are effective with limited data, but their linear formulations constrain representation capacity. Deep models learn more flexible representations but are prone to overfitting when calibration data are scarce. We propose KDHNet, which combines knowledge-driven analytical processing with data-driven representation learning. After filter-bank preprocessing, cascaded task-discriminant component analysis (TDCA) and task-related component analysis (TRCA) extract discriminative and trial-reproducible components. Learnable sub-band weighting then fuses spectral information, and an SSVEPformer decoder learns temporal and spectral representations for classification. translated_abstract: 基于稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）的脑机接口（BCI）实现了较高的信息传输速率，但通常需要充足的被试特定校准数据才能进行可靠解码。解析空间滤波器在数据有限的情况下是有效的，但其线性形式限制了表示能力。深度模型能够学习更灵活的表示，但在校准数据稀缺时容易过拟合。我们提出了KDHNet，它将知识驱动的解析处理与数据驱动的表示学习相结合。经过滤波器组预处理后，级联的任务判别成分分析（TDCA）和任务相关成分分析（TRCA）提取判别性强且试次间可复现的成分。随后，可学习的子带加权融合频谱信息，并由SSVEPformer解码器学习时间和频谱表示以进行分类。对于跨被试解码，一种目标引导的学
tldr: 提出KDHNet混合网络，将知识驱动的TDCA/TRCA解析处理与数据驱动的SSVEPformer深度表示学习相结合，在有限校准数据条件下实现了高性能的SSVEP脑机接口解码。
en_tdlr: KDHNet is a hybrid network that combines knowledge-driven analytical processing (cascaded TDCA/TRCA) with data-driven representation learning (SSVEPformer) to achieve high-performance SSVEP BCI decoding with limited calibration data.
